summary: Implemented Lambda (monai/transforms/utility/array.py, appended at end) and Lambdad with aliases LambdaD and LambdaDict (monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py, class inserted after ConcatItemsd, LambdaD/LambdaDict alias line appended last). Lambda asserts callable with "func must be callable" and returns func(img) unchanged. Lambdad validates keys via MapTransform, wraps func in one internal Lambda, and in __call__ shallow-copies with dict() and replaces each listed key. Docs: Lambda entry added before SplitChannel and Lambdad entry after ConcatItemsd in docs/source/transforms.rst. Tests added: tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py (identity and spatial-slicing callables, keys-view input, unlisted-key preservation, alias identity). Not run: tests, flake8, black, per instructions; verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
